text: Make Golden’s strategy a fixed-layout control packet passed by reference, deleting prose restatements at every boundary.
rationale: A shared bus carries one canonical owner-authored payload while exact routing and authorship remain intact.
trap: Fixed layout adds schema-like ceremony; direct roadmap reference already exists.

text: Add dirty-bit invalidation to strategy fields so unchanged lanes retain downstream evidence and only altered lanes reopen work.
rationale: Cache-coherence semantics remove repeated full passes without changing the required worker sequence for changed decisions.
trap: Field-coherence machinery exceeds guidance; existing relevant-proof invalidation already required.

text: Execute all 30 scores as a reduction tree, retaining a verdict bitmap and source offsets instead of thirty narrative copies.
rationale: Packed datapath reduction preserves every scorer’s result and source custody while deleting transcript bulk.

text: Set one end-to-end timing fence that discards intermediate prose polishing once the substantive packet is closed.
rationale: Timing closure prevents incidental text churn from creating repair cycles around already-valid work.
trap: Timing fence may discard substantive review; no deadline authorized.

text: Publish parent adoption as a versioned immutable snapshot pointer, letting independent acceptance snoop the same bytes under a separate authority clock.
rationale: Two authorities remain separate while duplicate context reconstruction disappears.
trap: Immutable plan references already exist; no new mechanism demonstrated.

text: Encode Luna/high design as bounded microcode with explicit source addresses and test hooks, forbidding explanatory expansion after trace closure.
rationale: Firmware-style traces preserve source checks and tests while removing non-executable design elaboration.
trap: Microcode overconstrains source reasoning and adds representation.

text: Cross-dock the design parcel straight into implementation, preserving citations, decision boundaries, and open questions.
rationale: The same artifact travels across handoffs without repacking.
trap: Already required exact adopted-roadmap delivery.

text: Use hub-and-spoke dispatch: the parent routes only each worker’s missing edge, while every spoke returns a self-contained artifact.
rationale: Routing stays centralized without rewriting worker-authored work.

text: Open a returns lane: acceptance defects go directly to the responsible owner with a typed failure reason.
rationale: Failed last-mile deliveries avoid retracing already-cleared stages.
trap: Existing targeted repair and FINAL rules cover it; typed reason adds ceremony.

text: Build a last-mile kit at adoption containing implementation steps, source receipts, and acceptance probes.
rationale: The delivery parcel arrives ready for coding and independent verification.
trap: Already adoption/roadmap required content.

text: Run a milk-run source expedition that collects receipts for every shortlisted design in one bounded route.
rationale: Related source custody travels together while remaining attached to each claim.

text: Reverse-logistics rejected ideas into explicit constraints on the next design brief.
rationale: Dead ends become routing information instead of recurring cargo.
trap: Already rejection handoff; must not violate isolated focus context.

text: Run a prediction market on failure modes, letting materially shifting risk estimates determine where design attention concentrates.
rationale: Buyers price risks, sellers submit forecasts, and a market-maker aggregates disagreement into targeted work.
trap: Prediction market machinery unsupported and likely costlier.

text: Treat uncertain source checks as verification options exercised only when implementation or acceptance touches the underlying claim.
rationale: The buyer purchases coverage, the seller supplies evidence, and settlement occurs against concrete delivery exposure.
trap: Defers required pre-adoption source verification.

text: Require each architecture proposal to post explicit invariants as collateral that acceptance can redeem or invalidate.
rationale: Design sellers stake correctness claims while the clearing mechanism localizes losses to broken invariants.

text: Build a provenance-preserving liquidity pool of accepted evidence that routine tasks can borrow instead of regenerate.
rationale: Evidence suppliers contribute reusable assets, buyers draw them, and the market-maker matches custody with current scope.
trap: Evidence pool adds state; existing evidence reuse sufficient.

text: Have opposing workers quote the cheapest safe path and the worst-case rework exposure, with the parent accepting the spread as its delivery budget.
rationale: The spread reveals hidden execution cost without changing authorship or acceptance ownership.
trap: Adds two agents and unvalidated estimates rather than removing work.

text: Use standing market orders for recurring low-risk task shapes, repricing only when a new failure signal moves their risk band.
rationale: Buyers get a fast route for familiar work, sellers reuse stable tactics, and market-makers reopen scrutiny on changed conditions.

text: Golden’s unit of work is not the whole request; uncertainty slices can travel through different stages while the final route remains exact.
rationale: This makes orchestration proportional to decision boundaries instead of request size.

text: Design does not have to precede implementation; a narrowly bounded implementation can serve as the design probe before source-checked refinement.
rationale: It turns speculative design prose into evidence without changing authorship or custody.
trap: Implementation before adopted design risks effects authority; probes require separate adopted scope.

text: A strategy decision is not single-use; it remains valid across related repairs until acceptance evidence falsifies it.
rationale: This removes repeated strategic recomputation while preserving independent acceptance.
trap: Same-outcome evidence reuse and local repair already required.

text: ADHD alternatives need not be prose proposals; they can be tiny executable probes scored by observed behavior.
rationale: The option space becomes evidence-producing rather than document-producing.
trap: Thirty executable probes expand effects/cost and break proposal-only scope.

text: Advice is not the first artifact; a concrete uncertainty or failure can summon targeted advice after local evidence exists.
rationale: This makes advice answer a live question instead of ceremonially preceding one.

text: Acceptance need not be conceived after delivery; its independent oracle can be authored when the work contract is formed and evaluated after change.
rationale: Separating oracle creation from execution preserves independence while removing duplicated framing work.
trap: Acceptance evidence already belongs in adoption.

text: Treat each Golden run as a resumable transaction with a local checkpoint after every accepted seam.
rationale: A 3am failure resumes from the last valid boundary instead of reconstructing or repeating completed work.
trap: Transaction/checkpoint claim invents runtime guarantee; TASK already holds stage memory.

text: Require every stage handoff to carry a one-screen recovery envelope: failed seam, reusable evidence, next owner, next action, stop condition, and escalation boundary.
rationale: The on-call engineer gets an executable diagnosis without inventing orchestration or changing worker authorship.
trap: Mandatory envelope duplicates existing cold-complete repair handoff.

text: Ship an offline replay pack that reruns literal checks and source-custody validation from captured artifacts without reopening strategy stages.
rationale: Most breakages become locally reproducible while preserving the original routing and evidence chain.
trap: Automatic replay cannot establish custody and adds helper surface.

text: Quarantine malformed worker artifacts behind typed handoff boundaries so unaffected outputs remain consumable.
rationale: A bad artifact triggers one bounded repair rather than paging the whole Golden pipeline.

text: Build a failure-to-recovery map during strategy selection, with one named repair path for each stage and seam.
rationale: Recovery decisions are made before the incident, eliminating ad hoc 3am diagnosis.
trap: Existing assignments already bind recovery; added map duplicates.

text: Make acceptance emit a release-neutral delivery receipt containing implementation evidence, required-test results, unresolved defects, and the explicit release-authority handoff.
rationale: A broken delivery is separated from a release decision, so on-call can close the engineering incident without assuming release authority.
trap: Parent acceptance and release separation already required.
